title: Why Do Rainbows Appear?
logline: A young guide named Mira and her cat Pip show children how sunlight and raindrops make a rainbow.

production.music: gentle curious instrumental, soft piano and light strings, slow tempo

cast.name: Mira
cast.look: young woman, shoulder-length copper-red hair, green scarf, brown jacket, friendly round face

cast.name: Pip
cast.look: small orange tabby cat, white chest, bright green eyes

places.name: Rainy meadow
places.look: wide green meadow, wet grass, low rolling hills, grey clouds, soft daylight

places.name: Grassy hilltop
places.look: grassy hilltop, golden hour light, wide open sky, distant green hills

rules: Mira is the only person in the video and Pip is the only animal
It rained shortly before the video starts, so the grass is wet

scenes.title: After the rain
scenes.summary: Sunlight returns after rain and tiny water drops still hang in the air.

scenes.title: Light splits into colors
scenes.summary: A prism and raindrops split sunlight into the colors of a rainbow.

takes.start_picture: Wide view of a green meadow after rain; Mira stands on the left side of the frame; Pip sits beside her; grey rain clouds above and pale sunlight breaking through on the right.
takes.motion: Mira looks up at the clouds while the light slowly grows brighter and Pip looks up too.
takes.end_picture: The same meadow; Mira stands in the center of the frame pointing up at the sky; Pip sits at her feet looking up; the clouds are thinner and the sunlight brighter on the right.
takes.shows: bright sunlight breaking through thinning rain clouds over a wet green meadow
takes.atmosphere: grey clouds thinning, pale sunlight growing stronger
takes.narration: After rain, sunlight breaks through the thinning clouds above the meadow.

takes.motion: Mira walks to the right across the meadow while Pip follows, and tiny water drops in the air glow in the sunlight.
takes.end_picture: Mira stands on the right side of the frame; Pip stands beside her; a faint arc of colored light begins to appear over the hills on the left.
takes.shows: tiny glowing water drops hanging in the sunlit air over the meadow
takes.atmosphere: bright sunlight, clearing sky, glowing mist
takes.narration: Millions of tiny water drops still float in the sunlit air.

takes.start_picture: Wide view from a grassy hilltop at golden hour; Mira stands on the left side of the frame holding up a small glass prism; Pip sits on the right side; a bright sun hangs low behind them.
takes.motion: Mira turns the prism slowly and a band of colored light spreads across the grass in front of her.
takes.end_picture: The same hilltop; Mira holds the prism steady in the center of the frame; Pip sits on the right side; a wide band of rainbow colors lies on the grass between them.
takes.shows: a prism splitting white sunlight into a band of rainbow colors on the grass
takes.narration: A prism bends sunlight and splits it into all its colors.

takes.motion: Mira lifts her hand toward the sky and a full rainbow slowly appears in the clouds above the hills while Pip watches.
takes.end_picture: The same hilltop; Mira stands on the left side of the frame; Pip sits on the right side; a bright full rainbow arches over the hills behind them.
takes.shows: a bright full rainbow arching over green hills after the rain
takes.atmosphere: golden light, clear sky with a bright rainbow
takes.narration: Raindrops do the same thing, so the sky shows a rainbow.
